description: Remove all temporary debug print() statements from a Python data processing project. The workspace is located at /home/ga/workspace/data_processor. There are debug prints scattered across 4 files in the src/ directory: processor.py, worker.py, config.py, and utils.py. All debug prints contain the text 'DEBUG:' in their output (e.g., 'print(f"DEBUG: message")' or 'print("DEBUG: message")'). You must remove ALL these debug print statements (approximately 20 total) while preserving: (1) Legitimate logging functions in src/logger.py which also use print() but are NOT debug statements, and (2) Test output prints in tests/test_processor.py. Use VSCode's Find in Files feature (Ctrl+Shift+F) to search for pattern 'print.*DEBUG' across the workspace. Review the results, then either use Replace in Files or manually delete each debug print line. Do NOT delete entire functions, only the print lines. Save all modified files when complete. The task is complete when all debug prints containing 'DEBUG:' are removed from src/processor.py, src/worker.py, src/config.py, and src/utils.py, while src/logger.py and tests/ remain unchanged.
